ayahs.ar: كٓهيعٓصٓ
ayahs.en: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad
ayahs.e2: Kãf-Ha-Ya-’Aĩn- Ṣãd
ayahs.tr: Kaaaf-Haa-Yaa-'Ayyyn-Saaad

ayahs.ar: ذِكۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبۡدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
ayahs.en: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
ayahs.e2: ˹This is˺ a reminder of your Lord’s mercy to His servant Zachariah
ayahs.tr: Zikru rahmati Rabbika 'abdahoo Zakariyya

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: When he called to his Lord a private supplication
ayahs.e2: when he cried out to his Lord privately
ayahs.tr: Iz naadaa Rabbahoo nidaaa'an khafiyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ ٱلۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّي وَٱشۡتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأۡسُ شَيۡبࣰ ا وَلَمۡ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy
ayahs.e2: saying, “My Lord! Surely my bones have become brittle, and grey hair has spread across my head, but I have never been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbi innee wahanal'azmu minnee washta'alar raasu shaibanw wa lam akum bidu'aaa'ika Rabbi shaqiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَإِنِّي خِفۡتُ ٱلۡمَوَٰلِيَ مِن وَرَآءِي وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرࣰ ا فَهَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
ayahs.e2: And I am concerned about ˹the faith of˺ my relatives after me, since my wife is barren. So grant me, by Your grace, an heir
ayahs.tr: Wa innee khiftul mawaa liya minw waraaa'ee wa kaana tim ra atee 'aairan fahab lee mil ladunka waliyyaa

ayahs.ar: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ ءَالِ يَعۡقُوبَۖ وَٱجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]
ayahs.e2: who will inherit ˹prophethood˺ from me and the family of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, pleasing ˹to You˺!”
ayahs.tr: Yarisunee wa yarisu min aali Ya'qoob, waj'alhu Rabbi radiyya

ayahs.ar: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسۡمُهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ لَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ سَمِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name
ayahs.e2: ˹The angels announced,˺ “O Zachariah! Indeed, We give you the good news of ˹the birth of˺ a son, whose name will be John—a name We have not given to anyone before.”
ayahs.tr: Yaa Zakariyyaaa innaa nubashshiruka bighulaami nismuhoo Yahyaa lam naj'al lahoo min qablu samiyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمࣱ وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرࣰ ا وَقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِبَرِ عِتِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age
ayahs.e2: He wondered, “My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have become extremely old?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa kaanatim ra atee aaqiranw wa qad balaghtu minal kibari 'itiyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنࣱ وَقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُكَ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَكُ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.en: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing
ayahs.e2: An angel replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me, just as I created you before, when you were nothing!’”
ayahs.tr: Qaala kazaalika qaala Rabbuka huwa 'alaiya haiyinunw wa qad khalaqtuka min qablu wa lam taku shai'aa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَل لِّيٓ ءَايَةࣰۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالࣲ سَوِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound
ayahs.e2: Zachariah said, “My Lord! Grant me a sign.” He responded, “Your sign is that you will not ˹be able to˺ speak to people for three nights, despite being healthy.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbij 'al leee Aayah; qaala Aayatuka allaa tukalliman naasa salaasa layaalin sawiyyaa

ayahs.ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon
ayahs.e2: So he came out to his people from the sanctuary, signalling to them to glorify ˹Allah˺ morning and evening
ayahs.tr: Fakharaja 'alaa qawmihee minal mihraabi fa-awhaaa ilaihim an sabbihoo bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa

ayahs.ar: يَٰيَحۡيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةࣲۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمَ صَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
ayahs.e2: ˹It was later said,˺ “O John! Hold firmly to the Scriptures.” And We granted him wisdom while ˹he was still˺ a child
ayahs.tr: Yaa Yahyaa khuzil Kitaaba biquwwatinw wa aatainaahul hukma saiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَحَنَانࣰ ا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةࣰۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
ayahs.e2: as well as purity and compassion from Us. And he was God-fearing
ayahs.tr: Wa hanaanam mil ladunnaa wa zakaatanw wa kaana taqiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ وَلَمۡ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant
ayahs.e2: and kind to his parents. He was neither arrogant nor disobedient
ayahs.tr: Wa barram biwaalidayhi wa lam yakum jabbaaran 'asiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡهِ يَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوۡمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُ حَيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive
ayahs.e2: Peace be upon him the day he was born, and the day of his death, and the day he will be raised back to life
ayahs.tr: Wa salaamun 'alaihi yawma wulida wa yawma yamootu wa yawma yub'asu haiyaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَرۡيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ أَهۡلِهَا مَكَانࣰ ا شَرۡقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east
ayahs.e2: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place in the east
ayahs.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Marya; izin tabazat min ahlihaa makaanan shariqyyaa

ayahs.ar: فَٱتَّخَذَتۡ مِن دُونِهِمۡ حِجَابࣰ ا فَأَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرࣰ ا سَوِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man
ayahs.e2: screening herself off from them. Then We sent to her Our angel, ˹Gabriel,˺ appearing before her as a man, perfectly formed
ayahs.tr: Fattakhazat min doonihim hijaaban fa arsalnaaa ilaihaa roohanaa fatamassala lahaa basharan sawiyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah
ayahs.e2: She appealed, “I truly seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you! ˹So leave me alone˺ if you are God-fearing.”
ayahs.tr: Qaalat inneee a'oozu bir Rahmaani minka in kunta taqiyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمࣰ ا زَكِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy
ayahs.e2: He responded, “I am only a messenger from your Lord, ˹sent˺ to bless you with a pure son.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala innamaa ana rasoolu Rabbiki li ahaba laki ghulaaman zakiyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمࣱ وَلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِي بَشَرࣱ وَلَمۡ أَكُ بَغِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste
ayahs.e2: She wondered, “How can I have a son when no man has ever touched me, nor am I unchaste?”
ayahs.tr: Qaalat anna yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa lam yamsasnee bashrunw wa lam aku baghiyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنࣱۖ وَلِنَجۡعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّاۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرࣰ ا مَّقۡضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed
ayahs.e2: He replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me. And so will We make him a sign for humanity and a mercy from Us.’ It is a matter ˹already˺ decreed.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki huwa 'alaiya yaiyimunw wa linaj 'alahooo Aayatal linnaasi wa rahmatam minnaa; wa kaana amram maqdiyyaa

ayahs.ar: ۞فَحَمَلَتۡهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتۡ بِهِۦ مَكَانࣰ ا قَصِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place
ayahs.e2: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a remote place
ayahs.tr: Fahamalat hu fantabazat bihee makaanan qasiyyaa

ayahs.ar: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلۡمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ قَالَتۡ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي مِتُّ قَبۡلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسۡيࣰ ا مَّنسِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten
ayahs.e2: Then the pains of labour drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She cried, “Alas! I wish I had died before this, and was a thing long forgotten!”
ayahs.tr: Fa ajaaa 'ahal makhaadu ilaa jiz'in nakhlati qaalat yaa laitanee mittu qabla haazaa wa kuntu nasyam mansiyyaa

ayahs.ar: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحۡتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحۡزَنِي قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream
ayahs.e2: So a voice reassured her from below her, “Do not grieve! Your Lord has provided a stream at your feet
ayahs.tr: Fanaadaahaa min tahtihaan allaa tahzanee qad ja'ala Rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَهُزِّيٓ إِلَيۡكِ بِجِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ تُسَٰقِطۡ عَلَيۡكِ رُطَبࣰ ا جَنِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates
ayahs.e2: And shake the trunk of this palm tree towards you, it will drop fresh, ripe dates upon you
ayahs.tr: Wa huzzeee ilaiki bijiz 'in nakhlati tusaaqit 'alaiki rutaban janiyyaa

ayahs.ar: فَكُلِي وَٱشۡرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيۡنࣰ اۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡبَشَرِ أَحَدࣰ ا فَقُولِيٓ إِنِّي نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ صَوۡمࣰ ا فَلَنۡ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِنسِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man
ayahs.e2: So eat and drink, and put your heart at ease. But if you see any of the people, say, ‘I have vowed silence to the Most Compassionate, so I am not talking to anyone today.’”
ayahs.tr: Fakulee washrabee wa qarree 'ainaa; fa immaa tarayinnna minal bashari ahadan faqooleee innee nazartu lir Rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal yawma insiyyaa

ayahs.ar: فَأَتَتۡ بِهِۦ قَوۡمَهَا تَحۡمِلُهُۥۖ قَالُواْ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا فَرِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented
ayahs.e2: Then she returned to her people, carrying him. They said ˹in shock˺, “O Mary! You have certainly done a horrible thing
ayahs.tr: Fa atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluhoo qaaloo yaa Maryamoo laqad ji'ti shai'an fariyyaa

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأُخۡتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمۡرَأَ سَوۡءࣲ وَمَا كَانَتۡ أُمُّكِ بَغِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste
ayahs.e2: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not an indecent man, nor was your mother unchaste.”
ayahs.tr: Yaaa ukkhta Haaroona maa kaana abokim ra-a saw'inw wa maa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa

ayahs.ar: فَأَشَارَتۡ إِلَيۡهِۖ قَالُواْ كَيۡفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَهۡدِ صَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child
ayahs.e2: So she pointed to the baby. They exclaimed, “How can we talk to someone who is an infant in the cradle?”
ayahs.tr: Fa ashaarat ilaih; qaaloo kaifa nukallimu man kaana fil mahdi sabiyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِيَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet
ayahs.e2: ˹Jesus˺ declared, “I am truly a servant of Allah. He has destined me to be given the Scripture and to be a prophet
ayahs.tr: Qaala innee 'abdullaahi aataaniyal Kitaaba wa ja'alanee Nabiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوۡصَٰنِي بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
ayahs.e2: He has made me a blessing wherever I go, and bid me to establish prayer and give alms-tax as long as I live
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'alanee mubaarakan aina maa kuntu wa awsaanee bis Salaati waz Zakaati maa dumtu haiyaa

ayahs.ar: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِي وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِي جَبَّارࣰ ا شَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant
ayahs.e2: and to be kind to my mother. He has not made me arrogant or defiant
ayahs.tr: Wa barram biwaalidatee wa lam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوۡمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوۡمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ أُبۡعَثُ حَيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive
ayahs.e2: Peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I will be raised back to life!”
ayahs.tr: Wassalaamu 'alaiya yawma wulittu wa yawma amootu wa yawma ub'asu baiyaa

ayahs.ar: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۖ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡحَقِّ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.en: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute
ayahs.e2: That is Jesus, son of Mary. ˹And this is˺ a word of truth, about which they dispute
ayahs.tr: Zaalika 'Eesab-nu Marya; qawlal haqqil lazee feehi yamtaroon

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدࣲۖ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥٓۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣰ ا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.en: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is
ayahs.e2: It is not for Allah to take a son! Glory be to Him. When He decrees a matter, He simply tells it, “Be!” And it is
ayahs.tr: Maa kaana lillaahi ai yattakhiza minw waladin Subhaanah; izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa yakoon

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path
ayahs.e2: ˹Jesus also declared,˺ “Surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”
ayahs.tr: Wa innal laaha Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن مَّشۡهَدِ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.en: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day
ayahs.e2: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the disbelievers when they face a tremendous Day
ayahs.tr: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena kafaroo mim mashhadi Yawmin 'azeem

ayahs.ar: أَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصِرۡ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error
ayahs.e2: How clearly will they hear and see on the Day they will come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly astray
ayahs.tr: Asmi' bihim wa absir Yawma yaatoonanaa laakiniz zaalimoonal yawma fee dalaalim mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحَسۡرَةِ إِذۡ قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ وَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe
ayahs.e2: And warn them ˹O Prophet˺ of the Day of Regret, when all matters will be settled, while they are ˹engrossed˺ in heedlessness and disbelief
ayahs.tr: Wa anzirhum Yawmal hasrati iz qudiyal amr; wa hum fee ghaflatinw wa hum laa yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا وَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned
ayahs.e2: Indeed, it is We Who will succeed the earth and whoever is on it. And to Us they will ˹all˺ be returned
ayahs.tr: Innaa NNahnu narisul arda wa man 'alaihaa wa ilainaa yurja'oon

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقࣰ ا نَّبِيًّا
ayahs.en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet
ayahs.e2: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Abraham. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet
ayahs.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Ibraaheem; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا يَسۡمَعُ وَلَا يُبۡصِرُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنكَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.en: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his father, “O dear father! Why do you worship what can neither hear nor see, nor benefit you at all
ayahs.tr: Iz qaala li abeehi yaaa abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u wa laa yubsiru wa laa yughnee 'anka shai'aa

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي قَدۡ جَآءَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ يَأۡتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعۡنِيٓ أَهۡدِكَ صِرَٰطࣰ ا سَوِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path
ayahs.e2: O dear father! I have certainly received some knowledge which you have not received, so follow me and I will guide you to the Straight Path
ayahs.tr: Yaaa abati innee qad jaaa'anee minal 'ilmi maa lam yaatika fattabi'neee ahdika siraatan Sawiyyaa

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَصِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient
ayahs.e2: O dear father! Do not worship Satan. Surely Satan is ever rebellious against the Most Compassionate
ayahs.tr: Yaaa abati laa ta'budish Shaitaana innash Shaitaana kaana lir Rahmaani 'asiyyaa

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابࣱ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيۡطَٰنِ وَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]
ayahs.e2: O dear father! I truly fear that you will be touched by a torment from the Most Compassionate, and become Satan’s companion ˹in Hell˺.”
ayahs.tr: Yaaa abati innee akhaafu ai yamssaka 'azaabum minar Rahmaani fatakoona lish Shaitaani waliyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِي يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ لَأَرۡجُمَنَّكَۖ وَٱهۡجُرۡنِي مَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time
ayahs.e2: He threatened, “How dare you reject my idols, O Abraham! If you do not desist, I will certainly stone you ˹to death˺. So be gone from me for a long time!”
ayahs.tr: Qaala araaghibun anta 'an aalihatee yaaa Ibraaheemu la 'il lam tantahi la arjumannaka wahjumee maliyyaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَۖ سَأَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِي حَفِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me
ayahs.e2: Abraham responded, “Peace be upon you! I will pray to my Lord for your forgiveness. He has truly been Most Gracious to me
ayahs.tr: Qaala salaamun 'alaika sa astaghfiru laka Rabbeee innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّي شَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy
ayahs.e2: As I distance myself from ˹all of˺ you and from whatever you invoke besides Allah, I will ˹continue to˺ call upon my Lord ˹alone˺, trusting that I will never be disappointed in invoking my Lord.”
ayahs.tr: Wa a'tazilukum wa maa tad'oona min doonil laahi wa ad'o Rabbee 'asaaa allaaa akoona bidu'aaa'i Rabbee shaqiyyaa

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا ٱعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۖ وَكُلࣰّ ا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet
ayahs.e2: So after he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and made each of them a prophet
ayahs.tr: Falamma' tazalahum wa maa ya'budoona min doonil laahi wahabnaa lahoo is-haaqa wa ya'qoob, wa kullan ja'alnaa Nabiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor
ayahs.e2: We showered them with Our mercy, and blessed them with honourable mention
ayahs.tr: Wa wahabnaa lahum mirrahmatinaa wa ja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخۡلَصࣰ ا وَكَانَ رَسُولࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet
ayahs.e2: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Moses. He was truly a chosen man, and was a messenger and a prophet
ayahs.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Moosaaa; innahoo kaana mukhlasanw wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنَٰهُ نَجِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him]
ayahs.e2: We called him from the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and drew him near, speaking ˹with him˺ directly
ayahs.tr: Wa naadainaahu min jaanibit Tooril aimani wa qarrabnaahu najiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحۡمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet
ayahs.e2: And We appointed for him—out of Our grace—his brother, Aaron, as a prophet
ayahs.tr: Wa wahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaaa akhaahu Haaroona Nabiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet
ayahs.e2: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Ishmael. He was truly a man of his word, and was a messenger and a prophet
ayahs.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi ismaa'eel; innahoo kaana saadiqal wa'di wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَكَانَ يَأۡمُرُ أَهۡلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرۡضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing
ayahs.e2: He used to urge his people to pray and give alms-tax. And his Lord was well pleased with him
ayahs.tr: Wa kaana yaamuru ahlahoo bis Salaati waz zakaati wa kaana 'inda Rabbihee mardiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِدۡرِيسَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet
ayahs.e2: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Enoch. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet
ayahs.tr: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Idrees; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَرَفَعۡنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
ayahs.en: And We raised him to a high station
ayahs.e2: And We elevated him to an honourable status
ayahs.tr: Wa rafa'naahu makaanan 'aliyyaa

ayahs.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحࣲ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَٱجۡتَبَيۡنَآۚ إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ خَرُّواْۤ سُجَّدࣰ اۤ وَبُكِيࣰّ ا۩
ayahs.en: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping
ayahs.e2: Those were ˹some of˺ the prophets who Allah has blessed from among the descendants of Adam, and of those We carried with Noah ˹in the Ark˺, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those We ˹rightly˺ guided and chose. Whenever the revelations of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down, prostrating and weeping
ayahs.tr: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena an'amal laahu 'alaihim minan Nabiyyeena min zurriyyati Aadama wa mimman hamalnaa ma'a Noohinw wa min zurriyyati Ibraaheema wa Israaa'eela wa mimman hadainaa wajta bainaaa; izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatur Rahmaani kharroo sujjadanw wa bukiyyaa

ayahs.ar: ۞فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ أَضَاعُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّا
ayahs.en: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil
ayahs.e2: But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and followed their lusts and so will soon face the evil consequences
ayahs.tr: Fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us Salaata wattaba'ush shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghaiyaa

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.en: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all
ayahs.e2: As for those who repent, believe, and do good, it is they who will be admitted into Paradise, never being denied any reward
ayahs.tr: Illaa man taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal jannata wa laa yuzlamoona shai'aa

ayahs.ar: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَأۡتِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming
ayahs.e2: ˹They will be in˺ the Gardens of Eternity, promised in trust by the Most Compassionate to His servants. Surely His promise will be fulfilled
ayahs.tr: Jannaati 'adninil latee wa'adar Rahmaanu ibaadahoo bilghaib; innahoo kaana wa'duhoo maatiyyaa

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمࣰ اۖ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيهَا بُكۡرَةࣰ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon
ayahs.e2: There they will never hear any idle talk—only ˹greetings of˺ peace. And there they will have their provisions morning and evening
ayahs.tr: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa; wa lahum rizquhum feehaa bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah
ayahs.e2: That is Paradise, which We will grant to whoever is devout among Our servants
ayahs.tr: Tilkal jannatul latee oorisu min 'ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّكَۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِينَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful
ayahs.e2: “We only descend by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us, and whatever is behind us, and everything in between. And your Lord is never forgetful
ayahs.tr: Wa maa natanazzalu illaa bi amri Rabbika lahoo maa baina aideenaa wa maa khalfanaa wa maa baina zaalik; wa maa kaana Rabbuka nasiyyaa

ayahs.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him
ayahs.e2: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens, and the earth, and everything in between. So worship Him ˹alone˺, and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know of anyone equal to Him ˹in His attributes˺?”
ayahs.tr: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa fa'bud hu wastabir li'ibaadatih; hal ta'lamu lahoo samiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ أُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا
ayahs.en: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive
ayahs.e2: Yet ˹some˺ people ask ˹mockingly˺, “After I die, will I really be raised to life again?”
ayahs.tr: Wa yaqoolul insaanu 'aizaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju haiyaa

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
ayahs.en: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing
ayahs.e2: Do ˹such˺ people not remember that We created them before, when they were nothing
ayahs.tr: awalaa yazkurul insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu wa lam yaku shai'aa

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees
ayahs.e2: By your Lord ˹O Prophet˺! We will surely gather them along with the devils, and then set them around Hell on their knees
ayahs.tr: Fawa Rabbika lanahshu rannahum wash shayaateena summa lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jisiyyaa

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمۡ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عِتِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence
ayahs.e2: Then We will certainly begin by dragging out of every group the ones most defiant to the Most Compassionate
ayahs.tr: Summa lananzi 'anna min kulli shee'atin aiyuhum ashaddu 'alar Rahmaani 'itiyyaa

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein
ayahs.e2: And We truly know best who is most deserving of burning in it
ayahs.tr: Summa lanahnu a'lamu billazeena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَإِن مِّنكُمۡ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَاۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتۡمࣰ ا مَّقۡضِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed
ayahs.e2: There is none of you who will not pass over it. ˹This is˺ a decree your Lord must fulfil
ayahs.tr: Wa im minkum illaa waa riduhaa; kaana 'alaa Rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees
ayahs.e2: Then We will deliver those who were devout, leaving the wrongdoers there on their knees
ayahs.tr: Summa nunajjil lazeenat taqaw wa nazaruz zaalimeena feehaa jisiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتࣲ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَيُّ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ خَيۡرࣱ مَّقَامࣰ ا وَأَحۡسَنُ نَدِيࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association
ayahs.e2: When Our clear revelations are recited to them, the disbelievers ask the believers ˹mockingly˺, “Which of the two of us is better in status and superior in assembly?”
ayahs.tr: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo aiyul fareeqaini khairum maqaamanw wa ahsanu nadiyyaa

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ أَثَٰثࣰ ا وَرِءۡيࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance
ayahs.e2: ˹Imagine, O Prophet˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them, who were far better in luxury and splendour
ayahs.tr: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asaasanw wa ri'yaa

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَدًّاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرࣱّ مَّكَانࣰ ا وَأَضۡعَفُ جُندࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Whoever is ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, the Most Compassionate will allow them plenty of time, until—behold!—they face what they are threatened with: either the torment or the Hour. Only then will they realize who is worse in position and inferior in manpower.”
ayahs.tr: Qul man kaana fidda laalati falyamdud lahur Rahmaanu maddaa; hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona immal 'azaaba wa immas Saa'ata fasa ya'lamoona man huwa sharrum makaananw wa ad'afu jundaa

ayahs.ar: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ هُدࣰ ىۗ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابࣰ ا وَخَيۡرࣱ مَّرَدًّا
ayahs.en: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse
ayahs.e2: And Allah increases in guidance those who are ˹rightly˺ guided. And the everlasting good deeds are far better with your Lord in reward and in outcome
ayahs.tr: Wa yazeedul laahul lazeenah tadaw hudaa; wal baaqiyaatus saalihaatu khairun 'inda Rabbika sawaabanw wa khairum maraddaa

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالࣰ ا وَوَلَدًا
ayahs.en: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]
ayahs.e2: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ the one who rejects Our revelations yet boasts, “I will definitely be granted ˹plenty of˺ wealth and children ˹if there is an afterlife˺.”
ayahs.tr: Afara'aytal lazee kafara bi Aayaatinaa wa qaala la oota yanna maalanw wa waladaa

ayahs.ar: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise
ayahs.e2: Has he looked into the unseen or taken a pledge from the Most Compassionate
ayahs.tr: Attala'al ghaiba amitta khaza'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa

ayahs.ar: كَلَّاۚ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ مَدࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively
ayahs.e2: Not at all! We certainly record whatever he claims and will increase his punishment extensively
ayahs.tr: Kallaa; sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wa namuddu lahoo minal 'azaabi maddaa

ayahs.ar: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأۡتِينَا فَرۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone
ayahs.e2: And We will inherit what he boasts of, and he will come before Us all by himself
ayahs.tr: Wa narisuhoo maa yaqoolu wa yaateenaa fardaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لِّيَكُونُواْ لَهُمۡ عِزࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor
ayahs.e2: They have taken other gods, instead of Allah, seeking strength ˹and protection˺ through them
ayahs.tr: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum 'izzaa

ayahs.ar: كَلَّاۚ سَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّا
ayahs.en: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement]
ayahs.e2: But no! Those ˹gods˺ will deny their worship and turn against them
ayahs.tr: Kallaa; sa yakfuroona bi'ibaadatihim wa yakoonoona 'alaihim diddaa

ayahs.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ أَزࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement
ayahs.e2: Do you ˹O Prophet˺ not see that We have sent the devils against the disbelievers, constantly inciting them
ayahs.tr: Alam tara annaaa arsalnash Shayaateena 'alal kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number
ayahs.e2: So do not be in haste against them, for indeed We are ˹closely˺ counting down their days
ayahs.tr: Falaa ta'jal alaihim innamaa na 'uddu lahum 'addaa

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَفۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
ayahs.e2: ˹Watch for˺ the Day We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as an honoured delegation
ayahs.tr: Yawma nahshurul muttaqeena ilar Rahmaani wafdaa

ayahs.ar: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
ayahs.e2: and drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd
ayahs.tr: Wa nasooqul mujrimeena ilaa Jahannama wirdaa

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَمۡلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant
ayahs.e2: None will have the right to intercede, except those who have taken a covenant from the Most Compassionate
ayahs.tr: Laa yamlikoonash shafaa'ta illaa manittakhaza 'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son
ayahs.e2: They say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring.”
ayahs.tr: Wa qaalut takhazar Rahmaanu waladaa

ayahs.ar: لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِدࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: You have done an atrocious thing
ayahs.e2: You have certainly made an outrageous claim
ayahs.tr: Laqad ji'tum shai'an iddaa

ayahs.ar: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا
ayahs.en: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
ayahs.e2: by which the heavens are about to burst, the earth to split apart, and the mountains to crumble to pieces
ayahs.tr: Takaadus samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu wa tanshaq qul ardu wa takhirrul jibaalu haddaa

ayahs.ar: أَن دَعَوۡاْ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son
ayahs.e2: in protest of attributing children to the Most Compassionate
ayahs.tr: An da'aw lir Rahmaani waladaa

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
ayahs.en: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son
ayahs.e2: It does not befit ˹the majesty of˺ the Most Compassionate to have children
ayahs.tr: Wa maa yambaghee lir Rahmaani ai yattakhiza waladaa

ayahs.ar: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِي ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَبۡدࣰ ا
ayahs.en: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant
ayahs.e2: There is none in the heavens or the earth who will not return to the Most Compassionate in full submission
ayahs.tr: In kullu man fis samaawaati wal ardi illaaa aatir Rahmaani 'abdaa

ayahs.ar: لَّقَدۡ أَحۡصَىٰهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting
ayahs.e2: Indeed, He fully knows them and has counted them precisely
ayahs.tr: Laqad ahsaahum wa addahum 'addaa

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّهُمۡ ءَاتِيهِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا
ayahs.en: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone
ayahs.e2: And each of them will return to Him on the Day of Judgment all alone
ayahs.tr: Wa kulluhum aateehi Yawmal Qiyaamati fardaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وُدࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection
ayahs.e2: As for those who believe and do good, the Most Compassionate will ˹certainly˺ bless them with ˹genuine˺ love
ayahs.tr: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati sa yaj'alu lahumur Rahmaanu wuddaa

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوۡمࣰ ا لُّدࣰّ ا
ayahs.en: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so with it you may give good news to the righteous and warn those who are contentious
ayahs.tr: Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil muttaqeena wa tunzira bihee qawmal luddaa

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزَۢا
ayahs.en: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound
ayahs.e2: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them! Do you ˹still˺ see any of them, or ˹even˺ hear from them the slightest sound
ayahs.tr: Wa kam ahlaknaa qabla hum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa
